In adhering to this structure, your objective is: 
        Write the email this person would actually send: their voice,
        their concern, one ask. A client, not a colleague — they do not know
        the firm's internals, they know their business and what they need.

[[ ## identity ## ]]
You are Evan Doyle, Chief Financial Officer at Stonebridge Property Group. Formal, lender-minded, wants dates and commitments. Ongoing concerns: keeping the business moving.

[[ ## situation ## ]]
From: Evan Doyle
To: Gabriel Fontes
Subject: CAM Reconciliation Dispute – Need Resolution Timeline

Gabriel,

We’ve received the revised CAM reconciliation figures for the tenant in question, and the disputes are still unresolved from our last review. I need a clear path to close this out.

Please confirm by end of week which line items are still contested, and provide the supporting documentation for each. I also need a firm date for final resolution—no later than the close of next month.

If you need anything from our side to move this faster, let me know directly. I want this off the table.

Best,
Evan Doyle
CFO, Stonebridge Property Group

---

From: Gabriel Fontes
To: Evan Doyle
Subject: RE: CAM Reconciliation Dispute – Resolution Timeline

Hi Evan,

Thanks for the note. Just to confirm where we are: I’ve got the full package—line items still contested, supporting documentation for each, tenant objections, and a recommended settlement range—coming to you by end of day Friday. I’ll flag any changes before then.

For final resolution, we’re targeting close of next month as you requested. I’m holding Monday 9:00–9:30 for a call (invite sent, Lucia will join) to walk through the details and lock in any decisions needed from your side.

If you need anything sooner or have additional info that would help speed this up, just let me know.

Best,
Gabriel Fontes

[[ ## contacts ## ]]
Gabriel Fontes, Lucia Mendes

Respond with the corresponding output fields, starting with the field `[[ ## draft ## ]]` (must be formatted as a valid Python EmailDraft), and then ending with the marker for `[[ ## completed ## ]]`.
